options.command: pnpm exec nx watch --projects draft-processor --includeDependentProjects -- pnpm exec nx build-deps draft-processor

commands: echo '🔍 Validating Terraform configuration for Draft Processor lambda...'

metadata.scriptContent: pnpm run build:declarations && cross-env BUILD_PLATFORM=web vite build
pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:mobile
concurrently -k -s first -n "SB,TEST" -c "magenta,blue" "pnpm run storybook" "wait-on tcp:6009 && pnpm run test-storybook"
pnpm run test && pnpm run test:stories

commands: cd lambdas/stats-lambda/dist && zip -j index.js.zip index.js
echo '🔍 Validating Terraform configuration for stats lambda...'
cd ../../terraform && terraform fmt -check || (echo '⚠️  Terraform formatting issues found' && terraform fmt)

aws logs tail /aws/lambda/legacy-sports-dev-stats --follow --region us-east-1
